# Livius.org

> > Comprehensive resource for ancient history, covering Rome, Greece, Egypt, Macedonia, Carthage, and classical civilizations through articles, archaeological evidence, and extensive photo archives.

Livius.org provides scholarly articles on ancient history, including detailed entries on historical figures, places, concepts, and events from classical antiquity. The site features an extensive picture archive organized by country and dynasty, documenting archaeological sites, sculptures, and monuments across the ancient Mediterranean and Near East.

## Key Topics

- Rome and Roman history
- Ancient Greece and Macedonia
- Ancient Egypt and pharaonic dynasties
- Carthage and Numidians
- Classical antiquity
- Archaeology and excavations
- Ancient sculpture and art
- Historical geography
- Greek mythology
- Mediterranean civilizations
- Ancient warfare
- Classical architecture
- Historical biography
- Ancient Near East

## Getting Started

- [Livius.org Homepage](https://test.livius.org/): Main portal for articles on ancient history, covering civilizations from Rome and Greece to Egypt and the Near East

## Historical Articles

- [Lucius Julius Caesar](https://www.livius.org/articles/person/julius-caesar-lucius/): Roman consul, Social War leader, and author of the Lex Julia citizenship law
- [Pothos](https://www.livius.org/articles/concept/pothos/): Greek mythology concept representing divine longing in Neoplatonism

## Picture Archives

- [Pictures by Country](https://www.livius.org/pictures): Comprehensive photo archive of archaeological sites and artifacts, indexed by country (Afghanistan, Albania, Algeria, and more)
- [12th Dynasty Egypt](https://www.livius.org/pictures/a/egypt/12th-dynasty/): Egyptian Middle Kingdom pharaohs including Amunemhet III, Senusret I, and Senusret III
- [Epidaurus](https://www.livius.org/pictures/greece/epidaurus/): Ancient Greek sanctuary of Asclepius featuring the famous theater, temples, and classical architecture
